$F_C = x \cdot (1 + F_S + F_V)$ (a C-flower, preceded by nothing or by a sequence ending in S or V)
$F_S = y \cdot (1 + F_C + F_V)$
$F_V = z \cdot (1 + F_C + F_S)$
